description: A React component class 'FilterScopeSelector' for managing and rendering filter scope selection UI in a dashboard application, including filter tree structures, search, and save/cancel actions.

classes.name: FilterScopeSelector
classes.description: React component class for selecting and managing filter scopes within a dashboard, including filter tree rendering, search, and save/cancel functionality.

methods.name: onCheckFilterScope
methods.description: Handles checking/unchecking filter scope nodes, updating filter scope map accordingly.

methods.name: onCheckFilterField
methods.description: Handles checking/unchecking filter fields, updating filter scope tree.

methods.name: onChangeFilterField
methods.description: Handles changing the active filter field, toggling between single and multi-edit modes.

methods.name: onSearchInputChange
methods.description: Updates search text state and filters the filter tree.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Saves the current filter scope selections and updates dashboard filters.

methods.name: filterTree
methods.description: Filters filter scope nodes based on search text.

methods.name: filterNodes
methods.description: Recursively filters nodes matching search criteria.

methods.name: renderFilterFieldList
methods.description: Renders the filter field tree component.

methods.name: renderFilterScopeTree
methods.description: Renders the filter scope tree component with search input.

methods.name: renderEditingFiltersName
methods.description: Displays currently selected filters for editing.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method for the component, including header, filter trees, and action buttons.
